name: Winter Solstice
title: Winter Solstice 2026 — the longest dark
description: On 21 December 2026 at 20:50 UTC, the sun reached its furthest south and the northern night became its longest. Real-time globe, ancient sun-aligned monuments, and pilgrimages from many traditions.
ogDescription: The longest northern night, the moment Newgrange floods with chamber light, the turning back toward the sun.
twitterDescription: The longest northern night — and the turning back toward light.
ariaLabel: Where the sun stood at the winter solstice 2026
noscriptIntro: On 21 December 2026 at 20:50 UTC, the sun reached its furthest south and the northern night became its longest.
articleDescription: On 21 December 2026 at 20:50 UTC, the sun reached its furthest south and the northern night became its longest.
schemaAboutDescription: The astronomical moment when the sun reaches its furthest declination south, the longest night in the northern hemisphere.

claims.template: The sun turned north over open sea, about {km} km from {place}, {country}.
claims.source: Sun position: NOAA solar series (Meeus), js/sunpath-math.js. Nearest land: GeoNames (CC BY 4.0) and Natural Earth (public domain).

claims.template: The day after this solstice, the sun moved {deg}° north; the day after the September equinox, {eqDeg}°.
claims.source: Sun position: NOAA solar series (Meeus), js/sunpath-math.js. Declination one day after each instant.

claims.template: From the September equinox to this solstice, {days} days and {hours} hours.
claims.source: Turning instants: Meeus, Astronomical Algorithms, ch. 27.

claims.template: At {lat}°N the sunrise stays within one sun-width of its southernmost point for {days} days around this solstice.
claims.source: Sun position: NOAA solar series (Meeus), js/sunpath-math.js. One sun-width is the sun's mean diameter, 0.533°.

claims.template: Since Eratosthenes measured the sun at Syene, around {bc} BC, the Tropic of Capricorn has crept {km} km toward the equator.
claims.source: Obliquity of the ecliptic: Meeus 22.2, js/sunpath-math.js.

claims.template: On the night of this solstice the moon crossed London's meridian {moon}° up, higher than the midsummer noon sun at {sun}°.
claims.source: Moon: Meeus ch. 47, topocentric, js/sunpath-math.js. Sun position: NOAA solar series (Meeus), js/sunpath-math.js.
